mechanism_relevant_findings: Proton conductivity is dominant in H2O atmospheres compared to D2O and dry conditions.
Conductivity is independent of pO2, confirming predominantly ionic (protonic) conductivity.
Protons are charge-compensated by oxygen interstitials.
limitations: Densification is challenging due to the thermal decomposition and volatility of phosphorus oxides.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides significant insights into proton conduction mechanisms at high temperatures.
